asha: onboarding nova-lite-6b-int4. quick smoke showed entity drops on long summaries vs fp16. suspect rotary index remap after head-packing change.

ben: did you use the new int4 packer (v2)? that changed packing groups, caused a phase shift for us earlier.

riley: can you paste minimal repro + export flags?

asha: repro: `Input: "Invite: André, Liña, and team to review Q2."`
fp16: `Attendance: André, Liña.`
int4: `Attendance: Lina.`  # dropped André and lost diacritic
Export cmd: `rw-export --format fused --rotary-mode perhead --norm none`

marta: quick checklist: 1) run tokenizer NFKC diff, 2) run fp16 through int4 runtime (no quant) to test kernel packing, 3) check kv-cache index remap.

rotary-lint-bot: detected `pack-v2` used at export time. recommendation: `rw-check-rotary --remap` and re-export with `--rotary-map remap-per-head` for v2 packers.

asha: thanks bot. i'll try re-export + push canary weights. will report results here.
